title: Invert Binary Tree
summary: Mirror a binary tree by swapping every node's left and right children.
algorithmSteps: Return immediately for an empty subtree.
Recursively invert the left and right subtrees.
Assign the inverted right subtree to the left and the inverted left subtree to the right.

examples.input: invertTree(new TreeNode(2, new TreeNode(1), new TreeNode(3)))
examples.explanation: The left and right child of every node are exchanged.

edgeCases: Recursion uses stack space proportional to the tree height.
